items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli
items.content_text:
### Development Tools & Utilities

*   [Lockpaw (⭐125)](https://github.com/sorkila/lockpaw) - macOS menu bar screen guard for unattended Gemini CLI runs. One hotkey covers the screen and blocks input while the agent keeps running (no sleep), and the locked screen glows plus fires a notification when Gemini CLI needs input or finishes, via a `lockpaw ping` hook. Touch ID unlock. Also works with Claude Code and Codex. Native Swift, free, open source.
